description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

Nothing you carry was built light, and nothing you carry has ever broken first.

Two-handed melee weapons you wield gain the shove trait, and when you critically hit with one you may push the target 5 feet directly away from you. Your two-handed melee weapons never gain the broken condition as a result of your own critical failure on a Strike.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Never gain broken from your own critical failure" is unbuilt -- no rule element overrides a weapon's own broken-condition trigger on a critical-failure Strike; that behavior is hardcoded engine-side, not a rule-element hook.
